newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Prices, turnover slip on Bucharest stock exchange.
newsitem.headline: Prices, turnover slip on Bucharest stock exchange.

text.p: Most Bucharest share prices moved lower on Tuesday as investors continued to play a waiting game.
"The market has slipped into a bearish phase, with investors keen to see fresh price lows," said a trader.
Two unofficial indices, the VAB and the BIG, dropped by 0.4 and 2.52 percent respectively from the previous session. BIG first-tier index slipped by 1.82 percent to 2,792.99 points.
"I don't think the market will deliver any surprises in the next two sessions, the bearish mood will stay on," another trader said.
Volume bobbed around the previous level of 1.8 million lei, while turnover lost 200 million lei sliding to 5.5 billion.
The first tier dominated trading, with 4.5 billion lei in turnover. Three of the four high-caps closed lower and one marked time.
Oltchim chemical plant and fertiliser maker Azomures both shed 100 lei each to end at 2,250 and 2,350 respectively.
Pharmaceuticals company Antibiotice retreated 500 lei to 4,100, while Terapia, the other pharmaceuticals firm, closed flat at 6,250.
Policolor dye maker focused investor interest on the second tier. It had 800 million lei in turnover but it closed 100 lei lower at 5,200.
Interest in the other second-tier stocks was minor, with eight stocks having no trade. Three companies were suspended pending announcements of their 1996 results.
